name: Maps Reviews Exporter
tagline: Export the Google Maps reviews of any business to CSV or JSON in one click.
how: Open any business in Google Maps.
Click the extension and press Collect reviews. It scrolls the list and expands long reviews for you.
Export CSV or JSON, or copy straight into a spreadsheet.
fields: Reviewer name and profile link, star rating, date (plus an estimated calendar date), full text, owner response, photo and like counts, and sub-ratings such as Food and Service. Every row also carries the place name, address and overall rating.
free: CSV export and copy to clipboard
pro: Filter by star rating and keyword
Summary: star counts, rating by month, owner response rate, most-mentioned words
who: Business owners tracking their reputation, agencies preparing audits, marketers studying competitors and researchers analysing customer feedback.
note: Maps Reviews Exporter is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
faq: Does it work on any business, or only my own?
Any place on Google Maps with public reviews: your business, competitors, restaurants, hotels, shops and so on.
Is there a limit on how many reviews it can export?
Free exports up to 50 reviews per place. Pro has no limit; places with thousands of reviews just take longer to scroll.

How do I unlock Pro after paying?
Your license key is shown on the receipt page and emailed to you. Open the extension, paste the key into "Paste license key" and click Activate.
Can I use it on more than one computer?
Yes. One key works on up to 3 browsers, for example your work and home computers.
I lost my license key. Where do I find it?
Search your email for the receipt, or sign in to your Gumroad library with the email you paid with. The key is on the receipt.
Does it work in Brave, Edge or Opera?
It's a Chromium extension, so it works in Chrome, Brave, Edge and Opera. It is being moved to new browser stores; check this page for the current install links.
